concerns.text: Task T012 (bias_correction.py) is described as needing to be invoked automatically after preprocessing and **before model training**, but it is listed after Phase 7 and Phase 6 in the task order, i.e., after final results are assembled. This violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule and breaks the user‑story independence guarantee for US‑2.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 7 – Robustness & data integrity (revision pass) T010, T011
concerns.text: Tasks T010 and T011 (enhanced download robustness and comprehensive testing) are placed after Phase 6 (final results) even though they are cross‑cutting robustness improvements that must be in place before the CI run validates the pipeline. Their current position means the final results could be generated without these safety nets, breaking the foundational‑first principle.
